metricDefinition: Full viewport backdrop with content temporarily hidden; project actual RGB onto field-a→field-b segment. Projection <0.5 is A-dominant, >=0.5 B-dominant; central .35–.65 is additionally reported as blend, not counted as a third theme color. Excludes rightmost 10px scrollbar. Dominance bounds allow 0.5 percentage point raster tolerance. This does not claim opaque cards are visible backdrop.
